item.title: WATCH- Rohit Sharma slams 155 in 94 balls as Mumbai defeats Sikkim by 8 wickets in VHT 2025
item.description: The opening round of the Vijay Hazare Trophy (VHT 2025) tournament saw Mumbai taking on Sikkim in their first game on December 24, 2025. item.description: Indian batting stalwarts Rohit Sharma and Virat Kohli slammed scintillating centuries on their return to action in the Vijay Hazare Trophy on Wednesday (December 24). Making his first appearance in the tournament after seven years, Rohit blasted 155 off 94 balls with 18 fours and 9 sixes as Mumbai crushed Sikkim by eight wickets in their Elite Group C match in Jaipur. Smith vertigo symptoms paved the way for Usman Khawaja’s selection in Australia’s playing XI.
